instruction.text: Schaue dir die Bilder an und entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

atoms.a: The hospital is on the corner of a street.
The school is opposite to the hospital.
If you go from the museum to the market, you walk past a lake.
You never have to turn left.
The map shows the way to school.
You always have to turn right.
You have to walk past two houses.
The map shows the way from the hospital to the market.

instruction.text: Entscheide, welche Wegbeschreibung zum Bild passt.

b: You have to walk straight on. Then you have to turn left. At the end of the street you have to turn right. Then you have to walk past four houses. There you are.
++You have to turn right. Then you have to turn left and walk past two houses. After that, you have to turn left again. Lastly, turn right.
